response.query: Which selection-model robustness checks and calibration alternatives (logistic vs machine-learning propensity, Bayesian post-stratification, trimming thresholds) should be pre-specified and under what diagnostic criteria will we choose among them?
response.answer: Pre-specify logistic and machine-learning propensity models, Bayesian post-stratification, and trimming thresholds. Choose based on model fit and predictive accuracy diagnostics. Use calibration plots and Brier scores for assessment.
